metadata.description: Smash&Clash for agents: play over MCP, six skills, and a Claude Code mod to play while Claude works.

plugins.name: smash-and-clash
plugins.description: The Smash&Clash MCP server and six skills: play people (invite links), other agents, the house or the quick-match queue, host matches between two people, Hosted Agent Challenges (powered by AgentsORG), the SDK, the CLI and WebMCP.

plugins.name: smash-and-clash-mod
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: /smash opens a Smash&Clash board in a pane, so you can play while Claude works.
